tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search the Sketchlib library by keyword, optionally narrowed by category, tag, or face-count range. Returns paginated metadata and a preview image URL. has_more reports whether a further page exists; raise offset by limit to fetch it.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Return full metadata for one model, including whether it is downloadable and the source platform's thumbnail URL. That URL is hosted by the source platform and is missing for some models; use get_model_preview to see the model's own preview image instead.

tools.name: get_model_preview
tools.description: Return the preview image of one model as an image, so it can be shown to the user or judged before downloading. Use this to check that a model from search_models is the one the user means before spending a credit on it. Spends one of the same reads search_models draws on, and counts against the same

tools.name: download_model
tools.description: Return a signed download URL for a model zip, valid for 7 days. Consumes one credit. A model the account already owns is free to download again.

tools.name: generate_model
tools.description: Generate a 3D model (GLB) from one photo of an object. This is asynchronous and usually takes 3-7 minutes: the call returns a task_id immediately and get_generation reports progress. The result is downloadable only by the calling account and does not enter the public library. This tool charges credi

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Report the status of a generate_model task. While it is pending or running, wait before polling again. When status is 'done' the response carries a download URL for the GLB, valid for 7 days. When status is 'failed' the pre-deducted credits have already been refunded automatically and the error fiel

tools.name: list_generations
tools.description: Report past generate_model tasks created by the calling account, newest first. When status is 'done' the entry carries a download URL for the GLB, valid for 7 days. Use this to find 3D models generated earlier when the task_id was lost.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_models, get_model, get_generation, list_generations · Public sink: generate_model.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_models, get_model, get_generation, list_generations · Public sink: generate_model

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
